children.text: At the repository’s root, where every agent finds it.
Warnings ignored from a problem’s menu. One that changes is listed again.
The Tailwind entry and its fonts. Sync reads and writes their tokens.
The design system is a summary on a quiet surface (what it holds, Open, Update with an agent), not a row among settings: it is a thing the project has.
DESIGN.md’s linter result is a dot and a word; with errors, Open goes to them in the Design system panel.
Stylesheets: one field per file, as Components.
Detect goes: Update with an agent and the Repository’s Detect again cover it.
